$comment: State of Power (SvS) preparation phase. Day names, day order and point values are taken from community reference sites (whiteoutdata.com, whiteoutsurvival.wiki), which agree with each other on the structure: five scoring days, then a sixth day when the winner is declared. Point values were only found on one of those sites, so they are still marked unverified — check one action in game and correct it under Game Data.
sourceNote: Day names and structure cross-checked across two community references. Point values from a single source, unverified.
phaseNote: Days 1–5 score. Day 6 (Saturday) declares the preparation winner at around 10:00 UTC — the winning state attacks, and the battle happens in the losing state's territory.

days.name: City Construction
days.summary: Fire Crystals, construction and research speedups, and Chief Charms. Have a Fire Crystal upgrade queued before the day starts so you can spend into it.
bank: Fire Crystals, Fire Crystal Shards and Refined Fire Crystals
Construction, research and training speedups
Chief Charm materials (Charm Guides and Designs)

scoring.label: Fire Crystal used on a building upgrade
Fire Crystal Shard used on research

tips: Refined Fire Crystals are worth roughly fifteen times a plain Fire Crystal here — save them for this day.
Points come from what you spend, so queue the upgrade first and rush it during the day.

days.name: Basic Skills Up
days.summary: Fire Crystals again, plus hero shards, the Lucky Wheel and gathering. A good day if you have been sitting on recruitment tickets.
bank: Fire Crystals and Refined Fire Crystals not spent on Day 1
Hero shards for ascensions
Lucky Wheel spins
Marches ready to send gathering

scoring.label: Fire Crystal used on a building upgrade
Fire Crystal Shard used on research

tips: Epic ascensions sit between the Rare and Mythic values — check yours and correct the rates.
Gathering is only 2 points a unit, but full marches out all day add up for free.

days.name: Beast Slay
days.summary: Pets and beast hunting. The one day that rewards stamina rather than stockpiled materials, so go in with stamina capped.
bank: Stamina — cap it out the night before and hold stamina items
Wild Marks for pet refinement
Pet advancement materials
Lucky Wheel spins

scoring.label: Pet refinement with Wild Marks — best tier
Pet refinement with Wild Marks — lowest tier

tips: Higher-level beasts score more (roughly 9,000 up to 12,000) — hunt the biggest ones your stamina allows.
Polar Terror rallies are the single best action of the day if your alliance will run them.

days.name: Hero Development
days.summary: Hero gear, Mithril and troop training. Mithril is the heaviest single item in the whole preparation phase.
bank: Mithril — do not spend any of it before this day
Essence Stones and Exclusive Gear Widgets
Chief Charm materials
A full troop training queue ready to run
tips: Mithril at 40,000 a piece dwarfs everything else — hold every scrap of it for today.
Troop points scale with tier (roughly 3 points at T1 up to 75 at T11), so train the highest tier you can.

days.name: Power Boost
days.summary: A catch-all final scoring day: pets, hero gear, Mithril, Chief Gear and Fire Crystals all count. Dump whatever survived the week.
bank: Anything left over from Days 1–4
Chief Gear materials
Mithril, Essence Stones and Widgets you could not spend on Day 4
Remaining speedups

scoring.label: Fire Crystal Shard used on research

tips: This is the safety net for anything you mistimed earlier in the week.
Ask your R4/R5 whether the state is close on points before emptying your bank into it.

days.name: Results declared
days.summary: No scoring. The preparation winner is announced around 10:00 UTC; that state becomes the attacker and the battle takes place in the losing state's territory.
bank: Healing speedups and healing resources for the battle phase
Shields, if you would rather sit the battle out
Full marches and rally slots ready
tips: Nothing you spend today earns preparation points — save it for the next cycle or the battle.
Check whether your state won before committing troops; being the defender changes the plan.
